**BCOP Credit Agreement:** A default by BCOP or any subsidiary guarantor in respect of certain provisions defined in the agreement may trigger a cross default under the BCOP Credit Agreement, allowing the lenders to accelerate the maturity of outstanding balances under the facility [1]. The interest rate swaps secured with a lien on BCOP and its subsidiary guarantors' assets pari passu with the credit agreement carry cross-default provisions. If a BCOP or guarantor default results in acceleration of the debt, the swap counterparty may terminate its hedge or swap agreement with BCOP and require all outstanding obligations under it to be settled [1].

**Nuveen UPA:** A default under any document evidencing borrowed-money indebtedness by Vistra Operations or any Guarantor Subsidiary that results in acceleration of indebtedness above the greater of 1.5% of total assets and $600 million may cause a cross default under the UPA. The payment obligations under the Nuveen UPA of Vistra Vision Holdings and/or any guarantor would then become immediately due and payable [1]. The passage does not describe any effect on interest rate swaps for the Nuveen UPA.
